nodes.description: Public uint256 flootPrice = 0.01 ether, the mint price read by claim().
External payable claim(uint256 tokenId) guarded by nonReentrant; requires msg.value >= flootPrice and 0 < tokenId < 7778, then _safeMint(_msgSender(), tokenId).
External ownerClaim(uint256 tokenId) guarded by onlyOwner and nonReentrant; requires 7777 < tokenId < 8001, then _safeMint(owner(), tokenId).
Public view tokenURI override that builds an on-chain SVG/base64 metadata string from tokenId.
Internal pure helper converting a uint256 to its decimal ASCII string, used by tokenURI.
Constructor initializing ERC721 name/symbol and the Ownable owner.
_safeMint(_msgSender(), tokenId) in claim: external mint that invokes onERC721Received on the recipient, enabling callbacks.
_safeMint(owner(), tokenId) in ownerClaim: privileged mint that invokes onERC721Received on the owner.
Payable value acceptance in claim: require(flootPrice <= msg.value) forwarding ETH sent by the caller.
tokenId argument of claim, bounded to 0 < tokenId < 7778 and used as mint id.
tokenId argument of ownerClaim, bounded to 7777 < tokenId < 8001 and used as mint id.
tokenId argument of tokenURI, used for image sizing and string conversion.
Local string 'size' in tokenURI derived from tokenId % 3 and embedded into the SVG metadata.

edges.reason: claim() reads the flootPrice state variable in its payable requirement.
flootPrice is compared with the caller-supplied msg.value inside the payment check.
claim() executes the require(flootPrice <= msg.value) payment check on the payable path.
claim() calls _safeMint after validating value and token id.
claim() uses _msgSender() as the mint recipient.
ownerClaim() is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing owner() with _msgSender().
The constructor calls _setOwner(_msgSender()), making the deployer the initial owner.
The minted token is delivered to the untrusted msg.sender through _safeMint.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient, which may reenter the contract.
tokenId is the claim() parameter whose bounds are enforced before minting.
The validated claim tokenId is passed straight into _safeMint.
ownerClaim() calls _safeMint(owner(), tokenId) after the range check.
tokenId is the ownerClaim() parameter validated against the reserved id range.
The reserved ownerClaim tokenId is forwarded to _safeMint.
tokenURI() consumes the tokenId argument it was called with.
tokenId is converted to a decimal string via toString(tokenId).
The local size string is packed into the SVG metadata returned by tokenURI.
tokenURI() internally calls the toString helper while assembling the JSON output.

normalization_plan.reason: The bound-checked tokenId argument only exists to be validated and forwarded to _safeMint inside claim, so it can be folded into claim as a non-core placeholder.
The tokenId argument of ownerClaim is only range-checked and passed to _safeMint, so it normalizes into ownerClaim.
The tokenId argument of tokenURI is only used to compute the size string and decimal suffix, so it can be merged into tokenURI.
The 'size' local string is a temporary computed value only used inside tokenURI's metadata assembly, so it normalizes into tokenURI.
